findings.reason: the roadmap schedules §7 as ready with no prerequisite gate, so a §7 node is dispatched with a done-when it cannot satisfy and its failure is attributed to the node rather than the missing wiring.
findings.text: §7's done-when ("the cited-command test the-crew-contract-fits-one-read §5 delivers passes with the new skill in its corpus") depends on that section landing, but plan-section-depends-on lists only s6→nothing-lands-unreached#s2; the prerequisite test tests/test_cited_commands_exist.py does not exist in the tree and the-crew-contract-fits-one-read is active at impl 0.35

findings.reason: the section's own measure cannot pass within its declared scope; the node must either be granted those paths or the done-when narrowed, and refusals.py/coordinator_obligations.py genuinely must follow the rename or the picker misroutes a composed `review` command.
findings.text: §7's done-when requires `grep -rn "review-plan" skills/ reckon/` to return no hit, but `review-plan` also appears in reckon/crew/refusals.py:90 (the D23 refusal message), reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:502 (_NEW_WORK_SUBCOMMANDS), reckon/schema/flight-defaults.yaml:152 and reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:1782, none of which are in §7's write paths

findings.reason: a node editing the named file changes nothing observable, so `reckon crew review-plan --help` still succeeds and the rename gate fails on a path the plan told it to take.
findings.text: §6 (and §7) name reckon/crew_run_commands.py as a write path for renaming `review-plan` to `review`, but the verb is `@crew.command(name="review-plan") def crew_review_plan` at reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:1782, imported by reckon/cli.py:224; crew_run_commands.py holds the ledger/run commands (its `ledger` command at :1908 is what §3 correctly targets)

findings.reason: §5 cannot be closed before §6, so the stated build order dispatches §5 to author a test importing a parser that does not yet exist, and the two sections double-claim one test file.
findings.text: the followup orders "§3 and §5 first; … §6 after §3", but §5's done-when parses a reviewer output "through the parser §6 installs" and both §5 (line 150) and §6 (line 172) list tests/test_health_review_parses.py as a write path

findings.reason: both figures are correctly drawn from the health-review-1010 evidence directory and the miscited filenames do not alter any section's mechanism or measure, so only the citation text would be corrected.
findings.text: the 45.3% (650 of 1,434) repeat-citation figure is attributed to health-review-yield/scan_summary.json, but that file holds no such figure (it is in health-review-yield/control_summary.json "recurrence_pre": first_citation 784 + repeat_citation 650 = 1,434), and the same table's "S22, 55 members" cell is cited to portfolio.csv, whose S22 rows number 43 (55 is the member count in sprints.json and docs/sprints/S22.html)

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — the §1 table's 45.3% figure is cited to health-review-yield/scan_summary.json, which does not contain it (it is in control_summary.json/control_out.txt), and the "S22, 55 members" cell is cited to portfolio.csv, which holds 43 S22 rows.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §3–§10 each name a declared negative control (verified present in the snapshot), but §7's negative-control-adjacent grep done-when (`grep -rn "review-plan" skills/ reckon/` returns no hit) cannot pass within its declared write paths.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — no gate or evidence is written to a session scratchpad or node-local temp; §11's evidence is the committed review record and the treatment node's own gate, and §3–§10 write repository test files and crew report paths that survive the run.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the proposed symbols and files (reckon/crew/findings.py, health_review.md, portfolio_review.md, test_dispatch_names_the_health_review.py) carry no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags; FINDING/TREATMENT/DISPOSITION are emitted output tokens, not symbol names.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §6 and §7 declare reckon/crew_run_commands.py as the write path for renaming the `review-plan` verb, but the reviewer and I verified the verb is defined at reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:1782, so the mechanism is aimed at a module that does not contain the code it must change.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — each section names one deliverable (a reader, a dispose option, a prompt, a verb, a skill, a portfolio rubric, a dispatch block, a velocity field, a proving run).
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — plan-section-depends-on declares only s6→nothing-lands-unreached#s2, but §7's done-when requires the cited-command test delivered by the-crew-contract-fits-one-read#s5, a dependency the plan needs and does not declare.
